correctness.rationale: For n>0 and alpha*d>0 set R=exp(u/(2n)), kappa=alpha*d/(2n)>0. Exact chain rule on source system (12) gives dot R=kappa(cosh(x/(2n))-R). Variation of constants from s<t and letting s→-infinity along a bounded complete trajectory gives the positive exponential convolution. Its input lies between 1 and cosh(max_K|x|/(2n)) on a compact invariant set K, proving R>=1 (u>=0) and sharp input-range bound. For any compactly supported invariant Borel probability measure, integrate the infinitesimal generator applied to R to obtain E[R]=E[cosh(x/(2n))]>=1+E[x²]/(8n²). Physical equation yields identical conjugacy with exp(rho v0) and kappa_phys=2rho Is0/C0. No assumed boundedness for arbitrary forward orbits and no finite simulation asserted as proof.
